The module is the IDE UI companion of the org.netbeans.modules.generic.project headless core: it provides everything user-visible for the generic project type — the logical view (a plain folder tree of the project directory, subject to the IDE's global file filter and the project's additional filter pattern), the New Project wizard, the project customizer (general and files categories), the project type menu and the "Open as Generic Project" context action.
The module exports no public Java packages. It contributes all its per-project services to the project type's lookup via @ProjectServiceProvider (so they appear in the lookup of every generic project, alongside the core's headless services) and the rest via layer/annotation registration:
The UI for the project type genericproject: LogicalViewProvider, CustomizerProvider2 and ActionProvider in the project lookup, the Templates/Project/Generic wizard entry, the Projects/org-netbeans-modules-generic-project/Actions menu, the Loaders/folder/any context action and the customizer category providers. Other modules may add further contributions to the same lookup (e.g. customizer categories via ProjectCustomizer.CompositeCategoryProvider.Registration).
Unit tests (GpProjectUiTest) cover the logical view (all files shown, the node's display name honoring the project display name override, the node lookup exposing the project and its directory DataObject), the ActionProvider (rename, delete, move, copy commands) and the file filter (IDE-ignored files hidden, the global filter toggle, the additional pattern, invalid patterns ignored). The headless behavior is covered by the core module's GenericProjectTest.
N/A - the module is already implemented.
A user chooses New Project, picks the "Generic" category, enters a name and location (optionally without a marker file in the working tree). The wizard creates the directory and the marker state in the headless core (GenericProject.setMarkerState) and the new project opens with a folder tree.
A user right-clicks a non-project local folder (Favorites, files view, ...) and chooses "Open as Generic Project"; the action marks the folder via the core and opens it in the project tabs.
A user opens the project properties (the standard "Customize" project menu entry, provided by the project type menu) and adjusts the display name (general category) or the file filter settings (files category: the global "ignored files" filter toggle and the additional pattern).

Standard Swing rules: the wizard, the customizer dialogs and the "Open as Generic Project" action run on the EDT (the action's performAction does its work directly, it is cheap). The logical view children are built lazily by the explorer on demand. The file filter reads project preferences and registers a property change listener; its state is only mutated from the EDT (settings changes) and read by the data filter, which tolerates the standard visibility of Properties.
